newsitem.title: UK: LME copper ends barely changed in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper ends barely changed in evening session.

text.p: - Three month copper was bid at $2,284 a tonne by 1800 GMT on Friday after an evening session that saw prices barely changed from their kerb close.
Copper was unable to penetrate the psychological $2,300 support level during the afternoon LME trading, although it closed $28 higher at $2,288.
The market received a lift from the start of a strike at Chile's Escondida copper mine -- the world's largest -- although production is not expected to be disrupted.
Aluminium was indicated at $1,551 a tonne in the evening trading, wiping off the small gains recorded in the kerb.
